title: Uterus and Ovaries
summary: The uterus (womb) is the muscular organ where a pregnancy grows; its lining sheds each month as a period. The two ovaries store eggs and make hormones like oestrogen and progesterone.
key_points: Roughly once per cycle an ovary releases an egg (ovulation).
Fallopian tubes carry the egg from the ovary toward the uterus; fertilisation usually happens there.
